assets.label: 二次元·按钮与切换控件
assets.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create original raster UI assets for Arena UI ANIME FANTASY mobile RPG collection. Elegant hand-drawn 2D Japanese-animation-inspired fantasy UI, precise colored line art and controlled cel-shaded edges, NOT chibi, NOT gritty dark metal, NOT photorealistic and NOT rounded toy 3D. Cohesive palette: icy ivory #eef5ff surfaces, midnight navy #24385c outlines, pale gold #eccb83 for primary actions/rewards, sky cyan #55c9ea for selection/energy, coral #ef7786 only for health, lavender #a998e5 only for epic rarity. Fine restrained gold corner filigree and a tiny geometric star motif, crisp readable silhouette. TRUE transparent RGBA background, no baked checkerboard, no backdrop, no floor, no cast shadow beyond an object's own boundary, no scenery, no device mockup. Strict front orthographic view, no perspective. No text, letters, numbers, captions, logos or watermarks. These are reusable UI skins: broad flat quiet central areas left completely blank for runtime Chinese text and numbers. Transparent gaps between all separate assets; each complete object entirely inside its equal grid cell with generous safe padding. Do not draw grid lines. One asset in each cell; no duplicate or extra assets.

Landscape canvas 1536 x 1024. EXACTLY 2 equal columns and 4 equal rows, eight 768 x 256 cells. One centered horizontal control per cell. Row 1 left: pale gold primary button unpressed, right: same shape darker inset pressed state. Row 2 left: ivory secondary button with navy outline, right: same button disabled in desaturated blue gray. Row 3 left: navy outlined ivory horizontal tab, right: matching selected tab with cyan underline and corner crystal. Row 4 left: horizontal toggle OFF, pale gray track and navy circular thumb on left; right: matching toggle ON, cyan track and ivory thumb on right. Buttons and tabs must be 560 x 130 in the requested design, equal left/right dimensions, 100-pixel horizontal inner text zone with absolutely no lettering; toggles approximately 240 x 110. Keep top/bottom 50 pixels empty inside each cell. Buttons moderately beveled with clipped corners, delicate star ornament confined to each far end, no ornament invading blank label area.

observations: 目视确认2列4行共8项：主按钮两态、次按钮两态、页签两态、开关两态；无文字，文字留白区完整。
偏差：高光、金边和渐变比简洁赛璐璐要求更突出，开关尺寸比240×110的提示更大；两种状态装饰和轮廓略有差异，不能保证切换无抖动。
原图1536×1024，alpha 0–254，完全透明像素约57.5%；各控件位于对应768×256区域，未发现跨格主体裁切。
逐格浅底预览检查通过；页面中文为叠字示意，并按原图实际文字区对齐，原图未改写。
目视确认2列2行共4块面板：通用弹窗、浅蓝背包、深蓝详情和金边奖励；内部留白，没有嵌入文字、物品或按钮。
请求1024×1024，实际1254×1254，每格627×627。alpha 0–255，完全透明像素约29.0%，面板内为填色、外部透明。
偏差：边缘有细碎红黄蓝色边及不规则抗锯齿，奖励面板上下装饰不对称；留白边距小于50/512的提示要求。
四格在预览中各自完整，没有混入其他格；当前没有九宫格拉伸参数，需另外确定边距并测试拉伸效果。
目视确认4列2行共8枚导航：英雄、背包、任务、商城、邮件、好友、排行、设置。采用一致的菱形金边和蓝白内图。
偏差：英雄、好友使用带头发的头像轮廓，而非纯简化胸像；图案和装饰更复杂，主体尺寸超过250×250且接近格子边界。
实际1536×1024，每格384×512；alpha 0–254，完全透明像素约64.6%。未发现重复或漏项，主体没有越过对应格子边界。
主观判断：轮廓用途可辨，小尺寸会损失头发、背包扣和奖杯装饰细节，建议配名称；这是一张八格图集，并非八个独立PNG文件。
目视确认2列4行共8项：红生命条、青能量条、金经验条、三实二空五星、青技能槽、紫装备槽、金币底板、盾形属性底板。没有文字或数值。
偏差：槽位比140×140的要求更大，星级额外带装饰底板；条形控件装饰较密。所有主体仍完整包含在对应格子内。
实际1536×1024，每格768×256；alpha 0–254，完全透明像素约55.7%。边框、填充和星级合并在一张图片中，无法直接作为动态数值控件。
页面以中文示例展示两块留白底板，原图不含这些数字；需要动态进度时应另行拆分图层或用代码绘制。

notes: 用户明确要求生成一套二次元组件UI、分类并提交GitHub；本次手动追加4张图集，规划28个设计项，分按钮、面板、导航、养成控件四类。
沿用anime-fantasy标识、独立运行目录和anime-文件名前缀。冻结对照提示词和已归档图片保持原样。
